component_method.entry: Replay first positive BUY from flat; freeze flag and original controls at its fill.signal_date T; BUY must match original T action/regime and execute valid_session=T+1. No future SELL/trade-exit population selection.
component_method.pressure: Last4 complete sessions including T: sum max(-log(Open[s]/Close[s-1]),0) > sum max(-log(Close[s]/Open[s]),0); equality or no down => false; missing warmup unavailable, never false fallback.

primary.late_return: Open[T+5]/Open[T+3]-1; fixed quantity and same single SELL fee cancel; no fresh BUY fee
primary.late_downside: max(0,1-min(Open/Close[T+3,T+4],Open[T+5])/Open[T+3]); initial unavoidable overnight excluded, no HL, not actual account/path DD

component_method.companions: first2=Open[T+3]/Open[T+1]-1; full4=Open[T+5]/Open[T+1]-1; (1+first2)*(1+late_return)=1+full4. Descriptive algebra only, no IC/CI/model.
component_method.maturity: late/full/risk mature at T+5 OPEN; first2 at T+3 OPEN; missing end stays NaN/NaT, no extension
component_method.counterfactual: hypothetical continuation across old actual exits, not native account PnL or a proposed exit implementation
component_method.quantity: first entry-session filled quantity documented only; labels normalized price returns, no quantity or future exit selection
